About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association.

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

CLdN is an international logistics player with a strong European network and a clear focus on efficient and sustainable maritime connections. For CLdN RoRo Agencies NV in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a motivated Customs & Border Compliance Officer for the logistics department.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 

As a Customs & Border Compliance Officer, you will follow up on all customs and compliance activities within Shipping, Port and Door-to-Door processes. You act as the link between internal teams, customers and authorities, ensuring a smooth and compliant flow of goods.
 
 

• Manage customs formalities and ensure compliance with applicable legislation. 

• Apply for and follow up on permits (AEO, bonded warehouse, temporary storage, …) and liaise with 
customs and port authorities. 

• Act as the point of contact for customs-related matters and support internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepare and improve procedures, KPIs and reporting. 

• Optimize processes and resolve operational issues. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a very good command of Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus. 

• You preferably have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field, with some exposure to customs, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You preferably have experience or knowledge in customs, shipping or port operations, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You are eager to learn and able to quickly process and master a large amount of complex information and legislation. 

• You have a hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving skills. 

• You possess excellent communication skills and easily build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

• You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every 12 weeks, including weekends/evenings).

Job description
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you’ll drive the engineering and 
execution of major BESS projects (typically >100M EUR investment).
 

● You are responsible for overseeing multidisciplinary design across electrical, civil, 
and structural engineering domains..
 

● You supervise EPC partners, engineering firms, consultants, and other external 
stakeholders throughout all phases, and coordinate internal teams including 
development, procurement, construction, and HSE.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you prepare technical specifications 
and lead tendering processes with suppliers, integrators, and contractors..
 

● You manage key technical domains such as: BESS system architecture, HV/MV 
substations, grid interconnection, cabling, electrical infrastructure, civil works, site 
infrastructure, etc.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you closely follow the project 
planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress 
and the milestones.

Your profile
 

● You have a Master degree in Engineering (Electrical, Industrial, Civil, …) or 
equivalent level of education.
 

● You have relevant experience in engineering or construction of large-scale energy or 
infrastructure projects (BESS or renewables preferred).
 

● Solid understanding of project development, permitting, and grid connection 
procedures.
 

● You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties 
involved.
 

● Excellent knowledge of English and French, able to communicate in Dutch is a plus.
 

● You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

jobs.description:
Are you a 
Finance professional with experience in Belgian accounting and a strong interest in an international environment? Do you speak 
Mandarin and English and enjoy acting as the link between different finance teams? Are you looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with 
international collaboration, communication and coaching?
 

 
 

You will join a 
dynamic international industrial group with activities across different markets and a strong presence in both Europe and Asia. Despite its international scale, the organisation maintains 
short communication lines and a personal, family-oriented approach. You will become an important link between the finance team in the 
Waregem region and the finance team in China, giving you a unique opportunity to work across cultures and finance environments.
 

 
 

About the company
 

The organisation is part of a 
large international industrial group with activities across multiple countries. The Belgian organisation operates in a 
dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will work closely with colleagues in Belgium and China and play an important role in ensuring smooth communication between both finance teams.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You follow up on 
purchase and sales invoices, payments and outstanding items and ensure that the Belgian finance administration is processed accurately and on time. 
This gives you a hands-on role with direct ownership of important accounting processes. 

• You perform and monitor 
bank bookings and financial transactions, while keeping the accounting records accurate and up to date. 
You will further strengthen your practical accounting expertise within an international environment. 

• You act as the 
financial point of contact between the Belgian site and the finance team in China, translating questions, clarifying processes and ensuring that information flows smoothly between both locations. 
This gives you broad international exposure and allows you to build a strong network across two finance organisations. 

• You support and 
coach finance colleagues in China on Belgian accounting principles, processes and reporting requirements. 
You can use your own experience to help colleagues develop while simultaneously strengthening your communication and coordination skills. 

• You will occasionally 
travel to China to strengthen collaboration with the local finance team and support the alignment of processes. 
This offers you valuable international experience and the opportunity to work directly with colleagues on-site.  

 
 

Profile requirements as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You have practical experience within 
Belgian accounting and are familiar with 
BE GAAP. 

• You speak 
Mandarin Chinese and English fluently, allowing you to communicate effectively with both the Belgian and Chinese finance teams. 

• Knowledge of 
Dutch is a nice-to-have. 

• You are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment. 

• You have a 
coordinating and communicative personality and enjoy acting as a bridge between different teams. 

• You are willing to 
travel to China occasionally as part of your role.

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground. 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.
